spans.claim: Helen Gilmore was found shot with the door open and a gun beside her

spans.span: Helen Gilmore lay in a half-reclining posture on a wicker couch.

spans.claim: The gun was an automatic pistol found beside the victim
spans.anchor: On the floor, beneath the outflung fingers of one hand, there was an automatic pistol
spans.span: On the floor, beneath the outflung fingers of one hand, there was an automatic pistol.

spans.claim: The door to Helen's room was found open at the time of the shooting
spans.anchor: The door of her room is open--her light is burning
spans.span: The door of her room is open--her light is burning!

spans.claim: A scream was heard before the gunshot
spans.anchor: There came to their ears the sound of a terrified scream

spans.claim: Kirklan Gilmore and the butler were downstairs when the shot was fired
spans.anchor: Mr. Gilmore and I rushed directly upstairs when the shot was fired

spans.claim: Fingerprints on the window glass matched Don Haskins
spans.anchor: Clear and distinct there were the prints of a man's fingers--on the inside of the glass
spans.span: Clear and distinct there were the prints of a man's fingers--on the inside of the glass.

spans.claim: The murder gun was identified as Sergeant Tish's police automatic
spans.anchor: This is my gun! Here's a little place chipped off one of the butt plates

spans.claim: Don Haskins was found hiding in the storeroom on the third floor
spans.anchor: Don Haskins leaned tensely against the wall of the storeroom on the third floor
spans.span: CHAPTER XXIII THE TRAPPED RAT With the breath wheezing noisily through his parted lips, which were twisted back so that his clenched teeth were bared, Don Haskins leaned tensely against the wall of the storeroom on the third floor of the Gilmore house.

spans.claim: A broken porcelain vase was found shattered in the victim's room
spans.anchor: Several other pieces like the one which he held in his fingers

spans.claim: Pieces of candle tallow were found scattered on the floor
spans.anchor: A bit of whitish substance which, as he picked it up from where it had been crushed flat into the rug
spans.span: Near the table, however, he did find something that he had overlooked until now; it was a bit of whitish substance which, as he picked it up from where it had been crushed flat into the rug, was moderately soft between his fingers.

spans.claim: A black hairpin belonging to Joan Sheridan was found in the victim's room
spans.anchor: Black hairpin! The dead woman's hair is blond

spans.claim: Kirklan Gilmore staged a loud explosion as an alibi
spans.anchor: He took the black porcelain vase as his alibi, put gunpowder into it and tamped it in with candle tallow
spans.span: He took the black porcelain vase as his alibi, put gunpowder into it and tamped it in with candle tallow, made a sort of firecracker.

spans.claim: Kirklan Gilmore accidentally shot his wife during a struggle
spans.anchor: I attempted to take it from her by force. I couldn't control myself
spans.span: I told her to put down the gun, and when she did not, I did a very foolish thing; I attempted to take it from her by force. I couldn't control myself.

spans.claim: Joan Sheridan found Helen alive after the shooting and tried to help her
spans.anchor: I opened the door and went in. I switched on the lights, bent over her
spans.span: I opened the door and went in. I switched on the lights, bent over her; that must have been when the hairpin fell from my hair, and I got the blood on my sleeve.

spans.claim: The explosion was timed to occur while Kirklan was downstairs with the butler
spans.anchor: I went out of the house, but returned almost immediately and rang the bell
spans.span: I went out of the house, but returned almost immediately and rang the bell.

spans.claim: The butler heard a door slam upstairs after the shot
spans.anchor: While we were mounting the steps, sir, we both heard a sound that seemed to be the slamming of a door
spans.span: While we were mounting the steps, sir, we both heard a sound that seemed to be the slamming of a door.

spans.claim: Don Haskins was the legal husband and a crook who blackmailed Helen
spans.anchor: She was Haskins' wife--his legal wife
spans.span: She was Haskins' wife--his legal wife.

spans.claim: Don Haskins was shot and died after a shootout with police
spans.anchor: Don Haskins was breathing heavily, his eyes closed, his hands clenched

spans.claim: The black specks in the candle tallow were burned gunpowder
spans.anchor: Those black specks in the tallow that have been worrying me all morning, were burned gunpowder
